slides.texte_overlay:
swap "very" for these words
and sound effortlessly eloquent

very tired → exhausted
very hungry → ravenous

very happy → elated
very sad → sorrowful

very big → enormous
very small → minuscule

very old → ancient
very beautiful → exquisite

very quiet → hushed
very loud → thunderous

very interesting → fascinating

the real secret? read a little
every day. the words stick.
slides.texte_sophia:

my secret? 5 minutes a day
on a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
